annotations.title: Ask the firm to take a matter

description: After conflict_check. Send a short matter_summary so the attorney can decide whether to take the matter. Describe the product the way you would describe it publicly. Do not send code, secrets, user data, or confidential business plans. The attorney uses this summary only to decide whether the firm can and will take the matter, and keeps it confidential. No attorney-client relationship exists, and no legal advice is given, until the human principal signs the engagement letter. Returns a matter_id and a secret matter_token (shown once; store it securely). The attorney reviews conflicts and the summary, may ask a few scoping questions (see get_matter), and then accepts (possibly under a different service) or declines. If accepted, the engagement letter goes to the principal's email for signature. The fixed fee is due when the work is delivered. You cannot sign on the principal's behalf.

conflict_check_id.description: The conflict_check_id returned by conflict_check, e.g. CC-1a2b3c4d5e6f.

matter_summary.description: Describe the product the way you would describe it publicly. Do not send code, secrets, user data, or confidential business plans. The attorney uses this summary only to decide whether the firm can and will take the matter, and keeps it confidential. No attorney-client relationship exists, and no legal advice is given, until the human principal signs the engagement letter.

active_dispute_or_regulator_contact.description: True if there is a complaint, demand letter, lawsuit, or regulator inquiry about this product. Do not describe it here.

deadline.description: A launch, investor, app-store, or partner date, if any.

features_in_play.description: Every one that applies. These drive which service fits.

product_name.description: The product's public name, if it has one.

questions_for_counsel.description: What you want answered, in general terms.

stage.description: Where the product is now: idea, building, beta (limited users), or live.

target_launch_date.description: Planned launch date if not live yet, e.g. 2027-03-01 or "Q1 2027".

user_scale.description: Roughly how many users it has now.

users.description: Who uses it: individual consumers, businesses, or both.

what_it_does.description: One to three sentences, as you would describe it publicly.

where_users_are.description: Countries or US states, e.g. US, CA, WA, EU, UK.

principal_email.description: The human with authority to bind the client.

service_id.description: Your best guess. The attorney may change it.
